title: vibecodekit-hybrid deliverables.json
description: Release-gate artifact emitted by the vibecodekit-hybrid VERIFY stage. Read by the HUD element, the Phase 4a GitHub Check Run gate, and `omc vibecodekit status|validate`.

slug.description: Deliverable identifier in lowercase-kebab-case. Generated by `omc vibecodekit scaffold` via the same slugify rule used in the CLI.

locale.description: Resolved locale for this run. Must already be normalised by resolveVibecodekitLocale() — no POSIX-style values like 'vi_VN.UTF-8'.

pattern.description: Vision pattern selected during VISION stage. Optional — null when scaffold ran without choosing a pattern. Must match a file under templates/vibecodekit-hybrid/vision-patterns/<pattern>.md.

verify_gate.description: Aggregate VERIFY decision. Null while the run is still in BUILD.

release_decision.description: Stable enum used by Phase 4a Check Run mapping and HUD label. Null while VERIFY has not run.

artifact.description: Repo-relative path to the verify report. Must live under .omc/.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.sss]Z) written by the VERIFY stage when the gate was last refreshed.

followups.description: Follow-up TIPs surfaced by sub-skill verdicts. Required when release_decision = SHIP_WITH_FOLLOWUPS or DO_NOT_SHIP.

allOf.description: When release_decision is SHIP_WITH_FOLLOWUPS or DO_NOT_SHIP, followups must be a non-empty array.

gate.description: Stoplight gate. The leading character is the canonical signal; the rest of the string is human-friendly label text.
